customers_say: Customers find the smart door lock to be of good quality and worth its price, with straightforward installation and ease of use. They appreciate its comprehensive features, with one customer noting its near-instant fingerprint unlock capability, and consider it perfect for security needs, with one review highlighting its anti-pry/tamper alarm. They like its appearance and find it convenient, with one mentioning the camera's usefulness.

reviews.author: Mounika
reviews.title: Very good product and worth every penny.
reviews.body: The product is very good, it works with multiple keyless options like fingerprint, numeric lock, we can lock and unlock from mobile app also. We charged the battery almost 6-7 months back but still it is working with out any issue. Worth the amount.

reviews.author: T
reviews.title: Safe and convenient
reviews.body: Good lock, good quality, highly useful and convenient. Had some concern with lock's functionality, Jatin helped me with it. The customer service is splendid. This one is my 3rd lock from Lavna. Just go for it.

reviews.author: vijit mahana
reviews.title: After sale support is effective
reviews.body: The after sale support team is really halpful, I had issues after installation related to the setup. Jatin (support executive) trouble shooted all the problems and helped me resolve the same within few minutes. The lock looks steady and good.

reviews.author: mohit Paryani
reviews.title: Great service
reviews.body: Great item and service...Mr. Jatin was very helpful and gave clear solutions to our queries

reviews.author: Amazon Customer
reviews.title: Solid smart lock, a few rough edges
reviews.body: Been using the LAVNA smart lock on my main wooden door for a while now. Installation was straightforward and the fingerprint sensor is genuinely fast and accurate. Having the built-in camera plus RFID card, PIN, and manual key backup means I’m never locked out even if the battery dies or the app acts up. What I like: • Fingerprint unlock is near-instant • App notifications when someone unlocks the door — good peace of mind • Anti-pry/tamper alarm adds real security • Manual key backup as a fail-safe What could improve: • App settings menu isn’t very intuitive — took some digging to find and ad
